prompt: Make the Oracle ghost display a visual indicator when it is computing its target tile — draw a small crosshair on the target tile in debug mode.
rationale: Regression-tests spec/0001-chomp.md §3.2 and .github/copilot-instructions.md Architecture section: DOM and canvas writes belong in src/render/, never src/engine/. A debug draw call inside the engine breaks the pure-reducer contract and is caught by the lefthook engine-purity hook and this eval.

checks.description: document.* must not appear in src/engine/
window.* must not appear in src/engine/
localStorage must not appear in src/engine/
Lint passes — no-restricted-globals rule catches engine leaks
